input.prompt: A single vintage 1970s ceramic EPROM chip in a long dual in-line package, seen straight on from the front, horizontal, centred, filling the width. The ceramic body is burnt terracotta orange enamel with a thin gold seal ring. The object alone on a pure black void, seen clearly. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no flags, no signs, no markings anywhere.
